title: Table of Nations

questions.question: Whose descendants are listed in Genesis 10?
questions.explanation: Genesis 10:1: The generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

questions.question: What is Genesis 10 commonly called?
questions.explanation: Genesis 10 lists the descendants of Noah and how nations spread across the earth.

questions.question: From which son of Noah did Nimrod descend?
questions.explanation: Genesis 10:6-8: Ham fathered Cush, and Cush fathered Nimrod.

questions.question: What happened to the nations after the flood?
options: They spread abroad on the earth
questions.correctAnswer: They spread abroad on the earth
questions.explanation: Genesis 10:32: From Noah's sons the nations spread abroad on the earth.

questions.question: How many sons of Noah are named as ancestors of nations?
questions.explanation: Shem, Ham, and Japheth - all three sons of Noah became ancestors of nations.

questions.question: Who is described as "a mighty hunter before the LORD"?
questions.explanation: Genesis 10:9: "He was a mighty hunter before the LORD."

questions.question: Which son of Ham became father of the Canaanites?
questions.explanation: Genesis 10:15-18: Canaan fathered Sidon and the Canaanite clans.

questions.question: What cities were part of Nimrod's kingdom?
questions.explanation: Genesis 10:10: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh.

questions.question: From which of Noah's sons did the Hebrews descend?
questions.explanation: Genesis 10:21: Shem was the father of all the children of Eber (Hebrews).

questions.question: Where did Nimrod go from the land of Shinar?
questions.explanation: Genesis 10:11: From that land he went into Assyria and built Nineveh.

questions.question: What does the name "Peleg" mean and why was he so named?
questions.explanation: Genesis 10:25: "in his days the earth was divided."

questions.question: Which famous city did Nimrod build in Assyria?
questions.explanation: Genesis 10:11: He went into Assyria and built Nineveh.

questions.question: Who were the sons of Japheth?
options: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, Tiras
questions.correctAnswer: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, Tiras
questions.explanation: Genesis 10:2 lists the seven sons of Japheth.

questions.question: Which peoples descended from Canaan?
questions.explanation: Genesis 10:15-18: Canaan fathered several peoples including Jebusites, Amorites, Hivites.

questions.question: Who was Eber's father?
questions.explanation: Genesis 10:24: Arpachshad fathered Shelah, and Shelah fathered Eber.

key_verse_text: These are the clans of the sons of Noah, according to their genealogies, in their nations, and from these the nations spread abroad on the earth after the flood.
